downed.rule: HP == 0: draw the hero portrait desaturated (luma, ~60% brightness), then portrait_downed.png on top at the same rect/scale (44x44 in the panel). Tap still opens the sheet.

levelUp.play: 12 fps, order 1-2-3-2-1, then off (about 0.4 s); pair with the level-up sound. Draw additively or normal alpha over the portrait.

note: Hand buttons stay icon-only (no action names on them).
